messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for inference-prod: HIGH 99p latency on /v1/generate, queue depth spiking. INC-2026. Auto-escalation will occur in 5m if no ack.

oncall-alex: Acked via PD — I’m on it. Checking dashboards now.

support-rahul: Seeing multiple customer reports: 3 distinct accounts reported timeouts ~1:12 AM UTC. Logs show repeated `KV cache miss` and `request queue timeout`. Pasting last error: `ERR: worker 17 OOM while allocating 2.4GB`

sre-jordan: GPU utilization for the primary pool at 98%, memory creeping up. Autoscaler not triggering — looks like scale policy rejected due to inflight KV cache locks.

oncall-alex: Trying a quick mitigation: redirecting traffic from model `redwood-1.2-large` -> `redwood-1.2-small` for non-SLA customers. Command: `rctl route set --from inference-prod --to redwood-1.2-small --filter 'tier!=enterprise' --duration 10m`

incident-bot: Automatic escalation to L2 in 03:00 (if no L2 ack).

oncall-maria: I’m L2, joining. Can we also bump the Dedicated pool by 2 GPUs as a short term? I’ll run the scale command.

sre-jordan: Maria, try `infra scale --pool inference-prod-dedicated --delta +2` and then monitor queue depth. If autoscaler still rejects, we should drain one node and restart the runtime to clear KV locks.

oncall-maria: Running `infra scale --pool inference-prod-dedicated --delta +2` now.

(oncall-maria 00:02): Scale acknowledged, new GPUs provisioning. Queue depth down ~40% after 90s. 99p latency moving from 3.1s -> 1.4s for a subset of routes.

support-rahul: Noticing timeouts reduced for earlier customers. One enterprise account still seeing tail latency spikes.

sre-jordan: Rolling restart scheduled to clear KV cache locks on node worker-17. Command: `infra ssh worker-17 -- sudo systemctl restart redwood-runtime` — doing this now, will cordon first.

oncall-alex: After restart, worker-17 rejoined healthy. Post-restart 99p across the fleet ~650ms.

pm-nina: Can we confirm customer impact window for the postmortem? Support reported ~1:08–1:18 AM UTC for the majority, with one enterprise spike until 1:21 AM UTC.

oncall-maria: Confirming — estimated impact: broad latency increase 1:08–1:16 AM UTC (customers saw 2–5s degradation), enterprise tail case till 1:21 AM UTC (timeouts). Severity: Sev2.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-2026 status: acknowledged -> escalated -> mitigation applied. Reminder to open a postmortem.

oncall-alex: Handing off monitoring to SRE rotation. I’ll document mitigations in the ticket and leave notes about the temporary route change.

sre-jordan: I’ll own the follow-up. Action items: 1) Fix autoscaler rejection path for KV lock cases, 2) add a graceful eviction for heavy-KV nodes, 3) run loadtest against redwood-1.2-large to reproduce.

pm-nina: Communicating timeline to the impacted enterprise customer on a call in 10m.

support-rahul: Closing customer-facing incidents once confirmed stable — will update support thread. :white_check_mark:

oncall-maria: Final check — metrics stable, 99p < 800ms for 5m window. Closing PD incident.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-2026 resolved by oncall-maria at 1:22 AM UTC.

oncall-alex: Thanks everyone. Postmortem owner: sre-jordan.

sre-jordan: Noted — creating postmortem doc and scheduling a 30m blameless review.
